credit_line: Gift of The Burnett Foundation and The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Vertical canvas of lush green leaves of corn.  An aerial view of the top of a corn stalk, with two main diagonally unfolding leaves curving out and away from the center of the stalk.  Leaves tinged with yellow and blue-green, fluidly expanding over the hints of a pinkish background.
